meta.description: Process a single PDF invoice: extract customer details and line items, check QB for existing customer, create if needed, then create invoice with line items.

parameters.text:
=Extract invoice details from the PDF text.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object — no explanation, no markdown, no code blocks:
{
  "customerName": "string",
  "invoiceNumber": "string",
  "invoiceDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "dueDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "lineItems": [
    {
      "Description": "string",
      "Quantity": number,
      "UnitPrice": number,
      "Amount": number
    }
  ],
  "customerTotal": number
}

IMPORTANT:
- customerTotal must equal the sum of all lineItem Amounts
- All numeric values MUST be numbers, not strings
- Dates MUST be in YYYY-MM-DD format

options.systemMessage: You are a PDF invoice parser. Extract and return a JSON object with customer name, invoice details, and line items. IMPORTANT: Return ONLY raw JSON. Do NOT use markdown. Do NOT wrap in ```json. Do NOT add any explanation.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, invoiceId: $json.Id, invoiceNumber: $json.DocNumber, customerName: $json.CustomerRef.name }) }}
